parallels.note: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.

translations.web: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”
translations.bsb: So if your whole body is full of light, with no part of it in darkness, you will be radiant, as though a lamp were shining on you.”
translations.kjv: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.
translations.asv: If therefore thy whole body be full of light, having no part dark, it shall be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining doth give thee light.
